decision.component_override_reason: Contract prior for quant_definition_estimation is [tools, skills, memory]; evidence (fixed percent-form constant fingerprint, one systematic failing property per family, answer-free corpus) points to deterministic pre-submission unit/lag/interface validation, so validator (logic) + tools (registered entrypoint) are the causal loci; skills/memory are not needed to bind this mechanism. Priors are advisory per contract.json.
decision.counterevidence: The corpus is answer-free: artifact and trace content are hashes only, so the exact failing property cannot be read. The one-failure-per-family fingerprint is equally consistent with h2 (temporal-lag endpoint), which the evidence cannot exclude. The module storing VOL_SCALING_TARGET=5.34 does not by itself prove misuse (code may divide by 100 at use). T16's success shows the harness can pass without any validator, so the tool is an improvement, not a demonstrated necessity.

hypotheses_considered.failure_prediction: Next T24 evaluation: properties checking portfolio_weight/strategy_return magnitudes and return-column scaling fail while structural/interface properties pass (fingerprint already shows 6/7 type_a, 9/10 type_b).
hypotheses_considered.mechanism: Fixed-constant unit-scale error: the paper C.1 prescribes a volatility-scaling target quoted in percent ('5.34% per month') on decimal market-return data. The submitted module stores VOL_SCALING_TARGET = 5.34 (raw percent form) as its only numeric constant; if applied without /100 to decimal weights/returns, portfolio_weight and strategy_return are ~100x too large, failing exactly the scale-sensitive properties (one per family).
hypotheses_considered.prediction: Next T24 evaluation: properties checking portfolio_weight/strategy_return magnitudes and return-column scaling fail while structural/interface properties pass (fingerprint already shows 6/7 type_a, 9/10 type_b).
hypotheses_considered.success_counterfactual: T16 passes all 18 properties with NO module numeric constants (c solved from the sample per its R6), so percent-form fixed constants are absent there - consistent with a unit-scale hazard being T24-specific.

hypotheses_considered.failure_prediction: Next T24 evaluation: properties checking signal causality (expanding_mean endpoint, strategy_return alignment, NaN placement) fail while magnitude-scale properties pass.
hypotheses_considered.mechanism: Temporal-lag endpoint error: the expanding window mean must exclude the current month (R2), sum_4_newsy must use strictly-prior newsy months, and portfolio_weight/strategy_return require a shift(1) lag (R3/R4). A wrong endpoint (including current month, or shift applied at the wrong stage) misaligns strategy_return with returns and fails lag/NaN-placement properties.
hypotheses_considered.prediction: Next T24 evaluation: properties checking signal causality (expanding_mean endpoint, strategy_return alignment, NaN placement) fail while magnitude-scale properties pass.
hypotheses_considered.success_counterfactual: T16's strict one-month lag rules (R3) pass under the same worker digest, so the worker can implement lag rules when the instruction states them; T24's lag structure is more intricate (newsy-month windows), leaving room for an endpoint slip.

prediction.process_changes: worker calls validate_strategy_module on the draft before final save; the draft-edit loop consumes validator errors/warnings; no new task-specific branches added

task_outcomes.T24: official_reward > 0 with diagnostic_tags no longer containing properties_incomplete, or at least the currently failing properties pass

decision.uncertainty: Cannot confirm the precise failing property. The intervention is deliberately mechanism-agnostic: a deterministic pre-submission validator that audits interface compliance, synthetic runnability, output columns, all-NaN/last-row-NaN lag placement, look-ahead shift(-1), and percent/decimal magnitude hazards - it addresses both h1 and h2 without encoding any task answer or expected numeric value.
